items.claim: In 2024, renewables supplied 32% of global electricity production.
items.synthesisExcerpt: The table for 2024 lists 10.0 trillion kWh of renewable electricity production out of 30.7 trillion kWh of total electricity production, reported as 32%.
items.sourceEvidence: The source abstract lists 10.0 trillion kWh renewable and 30.7 trillion kWh total electricity production, reported as 32%.
items.usefulness: Gives a concrete share for electricity production.

items.claim: The renewable share of global electricity consumption is unavailable in the table.
items.synthesisExcerpt: Total electricity consumption was 28.5 trillion kWh; the renewable portion is listed as unavailable.
items.sourceEvidence: The source abstract lists total electricity consumption as 28.5 trillion kWh and its renewable portion as unavailable.
items.usefulness: Clarifies that the electricity-production share cannot be presented as a consumption share.
items.qualification: The excerpt gives no renewable-consumption value.

items.claim: Renewables accounted for 7% of all energy production in 2024.
items.synthesisExcerpt: Across all energy production, renewables were 42.4 out of 605.6 quadrillion Btu, reported as 7%.
items.sourceEvidence: The source abstract lists 42.4 quadrillion Btu renewable out of 605.6 quadrillion Btu total energy production, reported as 7%.
items.usefulness: Contrasts the all-energy production share with the electricity-production share.
items.qualification: This measures energy production across all energy, not electricity alone.

items.claim: Renewables accounted for 7% of all energy consumption in 2024.
items.synthesisExcerpt: The renewable share of all energy consumption was also 7%.
items.sourceEvidence: The source abstract states that the renewable share of all energy consumption was 7%.
items.usefulness: Adds the all-energy consumption measure for comparison.
items.qualification: The excerpt provides no consumption totals or component values.

items.claim: The figures use a July 1, 2026 data vintage and may change.
items.synthesisExcerpt: This is a July 1, 2026 data vintage subject to change.
items.sourceEvidence: The source abstract identifies the data vintage as July 1, 2026 and says it is subject to change.
items.usefulness: Signals that the figures are time-specific.
items.qualification: The source notes that the data may change.

uncertainties: The synthesis does not provide a renewable share for electricity consumption.
The reported figures are subject to change.
endpoint: The inventory includes explicit 2024 renewable-share measurements and the stated data limitation and vintage.

operatorSourceAudit.locator: 2024 table, production and consumption columns, and data vintage note
operatorSourceAudit.evidence: Electricity production is 30.7 trillion kWh total with 10.0 renewable (32%). Electricity consumption totals 28.5 trillion kWh with renewable quantity and share unavailable. Total energy production is 605.6 quadrillion Btu with 42.4 renewable (7%), and the consumption share is also 7%. EIA reports a July 1, 2026 data vintage subject to change.
